description: SEC Form S-3 General Instruction I.B.6 "baby shelf" capacity: how much the issuer may raise off an effective shelf now, under the one-third-of-public-float cap that applies below a $75M non-affiliate float, less trailing-twelve-month takedowns. Returns the float basis, the cap, takedowns counted and the remaining raisable amount. `constraintApplies: false`: the cap does not bind (float >= $75M, primary offerings unlimited under I.B.1); this is neither "no capacity" nor a favourable finding. `constraintApplies: null` with `suppressedReason: "float_unmeasured"`: the float value was not measured, so whether the cap binds is unknown; it does not mean the cap does not bind and does not mean unlimited. A `suppressed` figure is withheld (e.g. an issuer delisted to OTC cannot run an S-3 primary): the capacity is not stateable, which is not $0 raisable. `suppressedReason: "ib6_pool_unattributed"`: the cap applies but trailing sales could not all be attributed, so $0 is a lower bound; `remainingCapacity` is null and capacity lies between `capacityLowerBoundDollars` and `capacityUpperBoundDollars` (at most the upper bound). `remainingCapacityBasis: "lower_bound"`: the figure counts unattributed rows whole, so capacity is at least `remainingCapacity` and at most `capacityUpperBoundDollars`. `staleIssuerStatement`: the issuer's own $0 statement dated `asOf` was not used because sales its window counted have since left today's window; it is what the issuer stated as of that date, not today's capacity. `poolDerivations`: ATM periods split by differencing the issuer's own stated sub-periods, each with its accession. `suppressedReason: "issuer_not_ib6_limited"`: the issuer's current prospectus offers more than the cap with no I.B.6 limitation (`issuerUnlimitedOffer`); whether the cap applies is not measured, and is neither $0, constrained nor unlimited. `floatValueBasis: "issuer_stated"`: the issuer's own printed I.B.6 float (`issuerStatedFloat`, prospectus <= 60 days old) was lower than the live valuation and was used. A null remaining capacity is not measured, not zero. Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Figures are as of `meta.asOfDate`, from filings read through `meta.filingsThrough` (a stale date predates anything filed since). Share counts are on one split basis; a row that cannot be rebased is omitted and counted rather than published on a mixed basis. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_baby_shelf_capacity
title: Get Baby-Shelf (S-3 I.B.6) Raisable Capacity
